subject: Zinia
fact: Zinia is a master spy who believes information must be gathered through conversation and observation.
source_quote: Zinia, always the master spy, decided that they needed information.

subject: Zinia
fact: Zinia noticed that the locals are common folk with no business or chores.
source_quote: Looking around, he noticed that these were all common folk, farmers, traders, and passers-by.

subject: Zinia
fact: Zinia realized the locals do not know the relationship to the Temple.
source_quote: Zinia thinks, “Ah, so these folks don’t know the relationship to the Temple. Good.”

subject: Zinia
fact: Zinia observed that the stout woman suspects Terjon played a role in Y’dey’s disappearance.
source_quote: The following person, a stout woman of indeterminate middle age, mutters that Y’dey, the head cleric of the village, has mysteriously disappeared. The priest, Terjon, is awfully closed-mouthed about the situation. She best that he played no small role in her disappearance as he is in charge now.

subject: Zinia
fact: Zinia believes the locals are prone to conspiratorial thinking about central authority.
source_quote: Zinnia reflects, “Distrust of central authority, and prone to conspiratorial thinking, Good.”

subject: Zinia
fact: Zinia understood that the locals see Verbobonc’s assimilation as a greater threat than the Temple.
source_quote: Zinnia connects the dots and explains to his companions, “The locals see the threat of being assimilated by Verbobonc as bigger than the temple. It’s probably related to their allegiance to the god Beory and Verbobonc’s theocracy.

subject: Jaroo
fact: Jaroo is the keeper of the blessed grove and believes Tieflings are outside the natural order.
source_quote: Zephyr immediately realizes that Jaroo is a druid who thinks that Tieflings are outside the natural order and have no place in the prime material plane.

subject: Jaroo
fact: Jaroo recalled the Moathouse as the outpost of the Temple of Elemental Evil and its role in enslaving and expanding its influence.
source_quote: “The mouthouse was once the outpost of the Temple of Elemental Evil, its watchtower an advance base for raids, looting, and destruction. From this area, servants of the Temple were to bring the Village of Hommlet and all the lands around it into subjection. The temple enslaved the conquered folk, and then they were forced to construct yet another fortress further west, spreading the evil power of the Temple in ever-growing rings to encompass all of the lands around its base.”

subject: Jaroo
fact: Jaroo recognized the uncovered outposts as mirroring the original Temple’s expansion pattern.
source_quote: “The circles of outposts that you and your friends have uncovered are too early, similar to the plots of the original temple, to be a coincidence.”

subject: Jaroo
fact: Jaroo instructed the group to investigate the Moathouse and report only to him.
source_quote: “You must go and investigate the Moathouse. And when you have found what you are looking for, you must tell me and me alone. Do not tell anyone else because the agents of the Temple may even be here.”

subject: Jaroo
fact: Jaroo distrusts Burne and Rufus’s intentions and fears they will restrict freedoms.
source_quote: Jaroo distrusts the intentions of Burne and Rufus, and Terjon's goals. ... As for Burne and Rufus, they may use whatever information they glean to restrict our freedoms.

subject: Rufus
fact: Rufus is the military commander of the area, powerfully built with a commanding presence.
source_quote: Rufus is a powerfully built man of average height with blue eyes, a delicate nose, and golden blond hair.

subject: Burne
fact: Burne is a young mage in a scuffed robe, secretly in a relationship with Rufus.
source_quote: Burne has a slight build, long brown hair, green eyes, and an aquiline nose. He’s wearing a mage robe with scuff marks and scratches on it.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia realized Rufus and Burne are romantically involved.
source_quote: Sequoia immediately understands that they are an item.

subject: Rufus
fact: Rufus deputized the group and demanded they report information to him first under threat of arrest.
source_quote: “I am the military commander of this area, and I am deputizing you. As my deputies, you are required to talk to me first. If you refuse my offer of being a deputy, I will have you arrested, or worse, if you explore the Moathouse. As my deputies, you are required to share any information with me, first. And then with anyone else.”

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia decided he would control what information he shared after encountering conflicting agendas.
source_quote: Sequoia smiles and nods. He has seen too many people with too many conflicting agendas, each trying to control the information flow and accomplish something slightly different. Once he has information, he will decide what to share.

subject: Terjon
fact: Terjon is the high priest of St. Cuthbert and demands exclusive access to all information.
source_quote: “Whatever information you get must be shared with me and me alone. The safety of the good people of Oerth may hang in the balance.”

subject: Zinia
fact: Zinia recognized Terjon’s demand as eerily familiar from others.
source_quote: But he does have one particular request that is so eerily familiar,

subject: Tower of Verbobonc
fact: The tower is 55 feet tall with a 35-foot inner tower, accessible by stone stairs and a lowering bridge, with machicolated battlements and arrow slits.
source_quote: This structure is some 55 feet tall, a smaller tower rising inside the greater at about 35 feet above the ground. Its entrance is accessible only by going up a curving flight of stone stairs, which terminate in a landing about 10 feet above the ground. The outer door of the tower lowers to form a bridge to the stone landing. ... The lower and upper battlements are machicolated, and the merlons are pierced for archers.

subject: Grove of Beory
fact: The grove is a place of worship with a carefully placed line of bluish stones leading to a rock cairn where flowers, nuts, berries, and leaf garlands are placed.
source_quote: A carefully placed line of bluish stones sets off the path to a rock cairn where flowers, nuts, berries, and leaf garlands are placed.

subject: Temple of St. Cuthbert
fact: The Temple is massive and imposing, ridiculously too large for the small village of Hommlet.
source_quote: A massive, imposing structure that is ridiculously too large for such a small village with so few souls.

subject: Jaroo’s true allegiance
fact: Jaroo was sent to observe events after the Temple’s defeat, but his ultimate loyalty and whether he acts independently remain unstated.
source_quote: From the conversation, he learns that Jaroo was sent here to observe the events after the defeat of the Temple of Elemental Evil.

subject: Terjon’s hidden agenda
fact: Terjon demands exclusive information, but his reasons beyond 'safety of Oerth' and his connection to the Temple’s destruction are unverified.
source_quote: “Whatever information you get must be shared with me and me alone. The safety of the good people of Oerth may hang in the balance.”

subject: Burne and Rufus’s ultimate goal
fact: Burne and Rufus are building a castle under Verbobonc, but whether they serve the Archibishop, the Church, or their own interests remains unspecified.
source_quote: Rufus explains that the heroes have discovered that there may be a resurgence of the Temple of Elemental Evil. ... “It would be essential that we present it to our boss in Verbobonc.”

subject: Zinia’s true identity
fact: Zinia imitates a recent convert to St. Cuthbert, but his actual motives and whether he is truly loyal to the Church are unverified.
source_quote: Zinia, for his part, does his best imitation of one.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia learned from Jaroo that the Moathouse was the original advance base for the Temple’s expansion.
source_quote: “The mouthouse was once the outpost of the Temple of Elemental Evil, its watchtower an advance base for raids, looting, and destruction.”

subject: Jaroo
fact: Jaroo stated the expansion ended with the Battle of Emiry Meadows.
source_quote: “This ended with the Battle of Emiry Meadows.”

subject: Rufus
fact: Rufus insisted the group report the resurgence of the Temple to Verbobonc’s leadership.
source_quote: “It would be essential that we present it to our boss in Verbobonc.”

subject: Zinia
fact: Zinia decided to retrieve the cleric Calmer after learning of Terjon’s demands.
source_quote: “We need to go get our cleric, Calmer.”

subject: Zinia
fact: Zinia secured accommodations at the Inn of the Welcome Wench, except for Zephyr who demanded the best room.
source_quote: From there, Zinia heads to the Inn of the Welcome Wench, where he and his traveling companions secure reasonable accommodations for reasonable prices, except for Zephyr, who is a spendthrift and demands the best room.
